generate_gmock_classes: generate Google Mock classes from a C++ header file by running gmock_class.py with the header path
generate_gmock_specific_class: generate a Google Mock class for a specific C++ class name from a header file
generate_methods_from_virtual_functions: generate MOCK_METHOD macros for all virtual non-ctor/dtor functions in a C++ class
generate_templated_mock_class: generate a templated Google Mock class with typename parameters from a templated C++ base class
generate_mock_with_namespace: generate a Google Mock class wrapped in the correct namespace from a namespaced C++ header
